description: Configure workspace custom UTM tracking defaults (Studio and Pro, admins and owners). Supports dynamic placeholders ({network}, {account}, {tag}, {postId}, {draftId}, {date}), domain exclusions, and preserving hand-written utm_* parameters by default. When enabled, new or updated tracked short links expand these parameters onto their destination URLs automatically.

brandId.description: The brand this is for, by its id from brands_list. Needed when the login has more than one brand; with one brand it can be left out.

campaign.description: Template for utm_campaign (up to 120 characters), such as "{tag}" or "q4-launch".

content.description: Optional template for utm_content (up to 120 characters).

enabled.description: true automatically applies these UTM parameters when creating or updating tracked short links; false pauses automatic tagging.

excludeDomains.description: Up to 30 hostnames (such as "youtube.com") where automatic UTM parameters are skipped.

medium.description: Template for utm_medium (up to 100 characters), such as "social".

overwrite.description: false (default) preserves hand-written utm_* query parameters already on a URL; true replaces them.

source.description: Template for utm_source (up to 100 characters), supporting {network}, {account}, {tag}, {postId}, {draftId} and {date}.

term.description: Optional template for utm_term (up to 120 characters).

name: utm_settings_set
title: Set UTM tracking defaults
